name: Create Link
description: Create a sharing link for a DriveItem. [See the documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/driveitem-createlink?view=graph-rest-1.0&tabs=http)

configurable_props.name: driveId
configurable_props.label: Drive ID
configurable_props.description: Identifier of a drive within a site

configurable_props.name: fileId
configurable_props.label: File ID
configurable_props.description: The file to download. You can either search for the file here or provide a custom *File ID*.

configurable_props.name: type
configurable_props.label: Type
configurable_props.description: The type of sharing link to create. Either `view`, `edit`, or `embed`.

options.label: Create a read-only link to the DriveItem
Create a read-write link to the DriveItem
Create an embeddable link to the DriveItem. Only available for files in OneDrive personal.

configurable_props.name: scope
configurable_props.label: Scope
configurable_props.description: The scope of link to create. Either `anonymous` or `organization`.

options.label: Anyone with the link has access, without needing to sign in
Anyone signed into your organization can use the link. Only available in OneDrive for Business and SharePoint.
